_doc: The curated network. Entries are rendered into the landing page by tools/build_site.py; the page ships no JavaScript, so nothing here is fetched at runtime. Candidates are reviewed by an agent panel (tools/curate_network.py) against the criteria below and land in `listed` or `held`, each with the reason. A project is never listed for being interesting — only for meeting the bar it claims.
criteria: Reachable: the repo resolves for an anonymous visitor.
Licensed: a LICENSE file with a real SPDX identifier. Public with no license is all-rights-reserved, and listing it would advertise a permission that does not exist.
Has a wish channel that works.
Carries wish-it-better.json at its root, parsing, with a level it has actually earned.
Declares its origin if it is a spinoff.

listed.title: Vibe Cards
listed.summary: Print CR-80 cards on a desktop inkjet, program the NFC chip inside them, and a 3D-printable enclosure for the reader.
listed.curator_note: The card app itself. Runs from a clean clone with no install step; the chip layer is verified against real hardware.
